hyperedges.label: Sales Workflow Skills Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: account-research feeds call-prep which produces call-summary — a coherent end-to-end sales call workflow, all using Common Room data

hyperedges.label: Finance & Compliance Skills Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: audit-support and close-management both address financial reporting accuracy and compliance (SOX 404, ICFR) — two phases of the same financial governance cycle

hyperedges.label: Creative & Visual Design Skills Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: algorithmic-art and canvas-design share a two-step philosophy-then-execution pattern, both referencing Anthropic brand guidelines for consistent UI/branding output

hyperedges.label: Sales Intelligence Cluster
hyperedges.description: These three skills together form the core sales intelligence pipeline: research contacts, understand competitive context, then craft personalized outreach.

hyperedges.label: Design Workflow Chain
hyperedges.description: Design critique → handoff → system management forms the end-to-end design-to-engineering workflow.

hyperedges.label: Data Analytics Stack
hyperedges.description: Data context extraction defines the warehouse schema, create-viz and data-visualization turn query results into insights — together they form the analytical workflow.

hyperedges.label: Product Insight → Roadmap → Metrics Loop
hyperedges.rationale: Research synthesis informs roadmap prioritization; roadmap execution is tracked via metrics review; metrics findings feed back into new research questions.

hyperedges.label: HR Employee Lifecycle Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: These four skills collectively span the full employee journey: sourcing/hiring, onboarding, performance evaluation, and aggregate workforce analytics.

hyperedges.label: Connector-Enhanced Skills Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: All five skills share the same structural pattern: standalone mode using user-provided data, plus a 'supercharged' mode when specific connectors (CRM, analytics, knowledge base, project tracker) are available — as documented in each skill's workflow section.

hyperedges.label: Enterprise Search System
hyperedges.rationale: These three skills collectively form the enterprise search pipeline: search decomposes queries via search-strategy and uses source-management to detect and prioritize MCP sources.

hyperedges.label: Agile Team Workflow
hyperedges.rationale: These four skills together support the full agile team communication cycle: sprint planning sets the work, standup tracks daily progress, and stakeholder-update/status-report communicate outcomes upward.

hyperedges.label: Skill Lifecycle Management
hyperedges.rationale: The skill-creator skill and its sub-concepts form a complete lifecycle system for creating, evaluating, and optimizing skills — including iterative eval loops and description tuning for accurate triggering.

hyperedges.label: UI Design Skill Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: All five skills focus on premium frontend visual design aesthetics — they share anti-pattern bans (Inter font, generic shadows), emphasize typography hierarchy, and are registered together in llms.txt as a design skill suite.

hyperedges.label: Data Analysis & Reporting Workflow
hyperedges.rationale: These four skills represent the end-to-end data analysis pipeline: write SQL queries, validate results, perform variance/financial analysis, and output findings to Excel. They are semantically connected through their shared concern for data accuracy and stakeholder reporting.

hyperedges.label: Product & UX Development Workflow
hyperedges.rationale: These skills represent the full product development lifecycle: research users, write the spec (PRD), design the UX, write the interface copy, and define a testing strategy. They are naturally sequential and complementary.

hyperedges.note: The stitch-skill generates DESIGN.md which encodes all design tokens for Stitch AI to consume in screen generation
